card.title: Which Way The River Runs
card.lyrics:
[verse]
You say it runs to the harbour
I say it runs to the sea
We have walked this bank for twenty years
[chorus]
And it runs where it wants to run
It never once asked me
It runs where it wants to run
And it carries you and me
card.note: Written SPARSE on purpose. Sung recall measured 92% on gospel (organ, claps, space) against 0% on arena rock (walls of distorted guitar in the voice's own range), and thinning neon_saturday took it from 5% to 68%. Few instruments, room around the voice, vocal named once.

tags_sent: sparse indie folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, wry, affectionate, clear female lead vocal
